about.label: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group
about.summary: Japanese bank holding and financial services company headquartered in Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan.
about.summary_cs: Japonská finanční skupina, největší banka v Japonsku.

about.label: Tokyo Electron
about.summary: Japanese electronics and semiconductor company headquartered in Akasaka, Minato-ku, Tokyo, Japan. Founded as Tokyo Electron Laboratories, Inc. in 1963, TEL is best known as a supplier of equipment to fabricate integrated circuits, flat panel displays, and photovoltaic cells.
about.summary_cs: Japonský výrobce zařízení pro výrobu čipů a displejů.

about.label: Toyota
about.summary: Japanese multinational automotive manufacturer headquartered in Toyota City, Aichi, Japan.
about.summary_cs: Japonská automobilka, největší výrobce aut na světě.

about.label: Advantest
about.summary: Japanese leading manufacturer of automatic test equipment for the semiconductor industry, and a manufacturer of measuring instruments used in the design, production and maintenance of electronic systems including fiber optic and wireless communications equipment and digital consumer products.
about.summary_cs: Přední japonský výrobce automatických testovacích zařízení pro polovodičový průmysl a měřicích přístrojů pro elektroniku a komunikační techniku.

about.label: SoftBank Group
about.summary: Japanese multinational investment holding company headquartered in Minato, Tokyo, that focuses on investment management.
about.summary_cs: Japonská investiční skupina, která drží podíly v technologických firmách, například v Armu a OpenAI.

about.label: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group
about.summary: Major Japanese multinational financial services group and holding company.
about.summary_cs: Japonská banka a finanční skupina, jedna ze tří největších v zemi.

about.label: Hitachi
about.summary: Japanese multinational conglomerate founded in 1910 and headquartered in Chiyoda, Tokyo. The company is active in various industries, including digital systems, power and renewable energy, railway systems, healthcare products, and financial systems.
about.summary_cs: Japonský průmyslový konglomerát, který vyrábí zařízení pro energetiku a železnici a dodává IT služby.

about.label: Recruit Holdings
about.summary: HR Tech holding company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. In FY 2024, it reported sales of 3.56 trillion Yen and revenue of 678.8 billion Yen, with more than half of its sales generated overseas.
about.summary_cs: Japonská firma, která provozuje pracovní portály jako Indeed a Glassdoor a personální agentury.

about.label: Sony Group
about.summary: Japanese multinational conglomerate headquartered at the Sony City building in Minato, Tokyo. The Sony Group is a highly diversified global conglomerate with businesses spanning video games, music, film and television, consumer electronics, imaging and sensing, semiconductors, financial services and others.
about.summary_cs: Japonský konglomerát, který podniká ve videohrách (PlayStation), hudbě, filmu, elektronice a obrazových senzorech.

about.label: Kioxia
about.summary: Japanese semiconductor memory and data-storage group headquartered in Tokyo. Its wholly owned principal operating subsidiary, Kioxia Corporation, develops, manufactures and sells NAND flash memory, solid-state drives, and related storage products.
about.summary_cs: Japonský výrobce paměťových čipů typu flash a SSD disků.

about.label: Mizuho Financial Group
about.summary: Japanese banking holding company headquartered in the Ōtemachi district of Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan.
about.summary_cs: Japonská banka a finanční skupina se sídlem v Tokiu.

about.label: Mitsubishi Corporation
about.summary: Japanese general trading company and a core member of the Mitsubishi Group.
about.summary_cs: Japonská obchodní společnost (tzv. sógó šóša) ze skupiny Mitsubishi, která obchoduje a investuje v energetice, surovinách, potravinách a průmyslu.

about.label: Murata Manufacturing
about.summary: Japanese manufacturer of electronic components, based in Nagaokakyo, Kyoto.
about.summary_cs: Japonský výrobce elektronických součástek, největší producent keramických kondenzátorů na světě.

about.label: Itochu
about.summary: Japanese corporation based in Umeda, Kita-ku, Osaka and Aoyama, Minato, Tokyo. It is one of the largest Japanese sogo shosha distinguished by the strength of its textile business and its successful business operations in China.
about.summary_cs: Japonská obchodní společnost (tzv. sógó šóša), která obchoduje a investuje v mnoha odvětvích od textilu po potraviny a suroviny.

about.label: Mitsui & Co.
about.summary: Japanese general trading company and a core member of the Mitsui Group.
about.summary_cs: Japonská obchodní společnost (tzv. sógó šóša) ze skupiny Mitsui, která obchoduje a investuje v surovinách, energetice a dalších odvětvích.

about.label: Panasonic Holdings Corporation
about.summary: Japanese multinational electronics manufacturer, headquartered in Kadoma, Osaka, Japan.
about.summary_cs: Japonský výrobce elektroniky, spotřebičů a baterií pro elektromobily.

about.label: Shin-Etsu Chemical
about.summary:
Largest chemical company in Japan. Shin-Etsu has the largest global market share for polyvinyl chloride, semiconductor silicon, and photomask substrates.
“Shin-Etsu” in the company's name derives from Shin'etsu Region, where the company established the first chemical plant as Shin-Etsu Nitrogen Fertilizer in 1926, though the company today is headquartered in
about.summary_cs: Největší japonská chemická firma, světová jednička ve výrobě PVC a křemíkových destiček pro čipy.

about.label: Takeda Pharmaceutical Company
about.summary: Japanese multinational pharmaceutical company.
about.summary_cs: Japonská farmaceutická firma, největší v Asii.

about.label: KDDI
about.summary: Japanese telecommunications operator. It was established in 2000 through the merger of DDI Corporation, a long-distance communications company; KDD Corporation, Japan's former state-monopoly international telecommunications provider; and IDO Corporation, a mobile network operator.
about.summary_cs: Japonský telekomunikační operátor, provozovatel mobilní sítě au.

about.label: Honda
about.summary: Japanese multinational conglomerate automotive manufacturer headquartered at the Toranomon Alcea Tower in Toranomon, Minato, Tokyo, Japan.
about.summary_cs: Japonská automobilka a největší výrobce motocyklů na světě.

about.label: TDK
about.summary: Japanese multinational electronics corporation that manufactures electronic components and recording and data-storage media.
about.summary_cs: Japonský výrobce elektronických součástek a baterií.
